atoms.b: For plants to reproduce, ((fermentation ++pollination)) is a very important process. During this process, seeds are created within the flower, which then create new ((++plants pollen)).
Most plants need ((humans ++insects)) for pollination, but some plants can also be pollinated by the ((waves ++wind))!
Bees, butterflies, beetles and some birds and bats can all help ((++pollinate digest)) plants.
These animals are attracted by the sweet scent and brightly coloured flower ((++petals roots)). After landing, they gather ((++nectar notes)) — a sugary drink that is produced by the flower.

As they fly from flower to flower, ((++pollen carpel)) from the plants’ stamens sticks onto the animals’ bodies. The pollen flies with the animals and sticks to the sticky ((++stigma petals)) of the next flower.
Now the plant can produce ((++seeds pollen)), which create new plants.

atoms.a: Pollen is only transported by wind.

feedback.end: Without bees and other insects, many plants wouldn’t be able to reproduce. This would have very negative consequences for the environment. Therefore, it is important not to kill insects, even though you might be scared of them.
